Although there is some evidence to suggest that
the insitu horizontal stress in residual soils and
saprolites is low, measurements of Kg are lacking.
Suitable methods for measuring Kg in the field
should be investigated.

A large amount of settlement data has been
obtained during the construction of the Mass
Transit Railway underground stations and other
deep basement excavations. It would be useful to
try to establish settlement curves from these
data, similar to those derived by Peck, for Hong
Kong residual soils and saprolites.
